iterations.plan: Implement particle attachment by detecting batchim for Hangul syllables and handling the special ㄹ case for "으로/로", treating digit-only words as having batchim.
iterations.code:
def attach_particle(word: str, particle: str) -> str:
    """
    Attach the correct form of a Korean particle to the given word.

    Parameters
    ----------
    word : str
        The word to which a particle will be attached. It may end in a Hangul
        syllable or in digits.
    particle : str
        One of the five particle forms: "은/는", "이/가", "을/를",
        "과/와", or "으로/로".

    Returns
    -------
    str
        The word followed by the correct particle form.
    """
    # Define indices for the 28 possible jongseong (batchim) in a Hangul syllable
    # The index 0 corresponds to no batchim.
    # The index 6 corresponds to the final consonant ㄹ.
    BATCHIM_INDEX_R = 6

    # Helper to determine if the last character has a batchim
    def has_batchim(ch: str) -> bool:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 0xAC00 <= code <= 0xD7A3:  # Hangul syllable block
            offset = code - 0xAC00
            jongseong_index = offset % 28
            return jongseong_index != 0
        # Treat numeric characters as if they always have a batchim
        return ch.isdigit()

    # Helper to determine if the last character is the specific final consonant ㄹ
    def ends_with_r(ch: str) -> bool:
        code = ord(ch)
        if 0xAC00 <= code <= 0xD7A3:
            offset = code - 0xAC00
            jongseong_index = offset % 28
            return jongseong_index == BATCHIM_INDEX_R
        return False

    # Decide which part of the particle to use
    if particle == "은/는":
        part = "은" if has_batchim(word[-1]) else "는"
    elif particle == "이/가":
        part = "이" if has_batchim(word[-1]) else "가"
    elif particle == "을/를":
        part = "을" if has_batchim(word[-1]) else "를"
    elif particle == "과/와":
        part = "과" if has_batchim(word[-1]) else "와"
    elif particle == "으로/로":
        # Special rule: if last character ends with ㄹ, treat as vowel
        if ends_with_r(word[-1]):
            part = "로"
        else:
            part = "으로" if has_batchim(word[-1]) else "로"
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported particle: {particle}")

    return word + part
